name: negative-shift
message: shift(-1) pulls future values into the current row
hint: Shift by a positive number of rows (look back). Forward-looking label code belongs in a function marked '# peekproof: label'.

name: shuffled-split
message: train_test_split shuffles rows by default (future rows reach training)
hint: Split by time: train_test_split(..., shuffle=False), TimeSeriesSplit, or a purged/embargoed splitter.

name: backward-fill
message: bfill() copies later observations into earlier rows
hint: Use ffill() so a gap is filled from the past only, or leave the gap and drop it.
